about: Rules 1.60 (Doors 3.0): each alpha skill's two forks, at 4 and 6 points of it (skills.json `forks`), two options each, picked once out of a fight through door/pick and kept for good. One row per option: a door verb (kind verb, held only by a sheet that picked it: requires door_pick) whose effects are item ops on the door's own resource. A row marked `shelved` is not built (its rule waits on a primitive not approved, `waits_for`, or on its step's other option): its step is offered only when both of its options are built. Figments keeps its forks in figments.json (its options are forms).

items.name: Long Thread
items.text: Bond reach +{=numbers.reach} tiles · first Mend or Shield on each Bonded ally each round costs {=numbers.ap|abs} AP less (min {=numbers.min})
items.why: A price cannot see its target (the cost trigger resolves no target: N20, not approved), so once per Bonded ally per round cannot be counted; the spec's cheaper wording (uncapped) is the one it rejects.

items.name: Round of Blessings
items.text: Whisper an ally unblessed last round: Hymn wait {=numbers.cut} round shorter, or next prayer roll {=numbers.roll|signed}
items.why: The Hymn's wait is not a count an op can move and the prayer roll is on no hook (N7, not approved). The cheaper wording (the next Hymn's heal or shield ×1.25) needs a predicate that tells a Hymn's heal from a Whisper's: both reach heal_in as kind blessing.

items.name: Steadfast
items.text: Once a round, off your turn: say a Whisper as a reaction when a foe attacks an ally you see
items.why: A prayer as a reaction needs N6 (not approved). The cheaper wording (Health or Protection held on an ally, landing at its first hit) needs the Whisper's amount on a condition row, and a Whisper's heal and shield are faith.ts code (prayerAmount), not an amount block a row can deal.

items.name: Benediction
items.text: A Whisper on an ally may go wide: +{=numbers.ap} AP · allies within {=numbers.within} tile get {=numbers.share|pct}% · +{=numbers.wait} round Hymn wait
items.why: The blessing runner reads no targets and the Hymn's wait is no count (N5, N7, not approved); the spec's cheaper wording (Intercession) is the one it rejects.

items.name: Held Breath
items.text: A turn with no Whisper is held (max {=numbers.held}): say it later as well as that turn's Whisper
items.why: Whispers a turn are a literal, not a stat (N7, not approved); the spec's cheaper wording is to drop it.
